title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in flexmls Flexmls®…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in flexmls Flexmls® IDX versions up to 4.1.2. This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing an attacker to inject malicious scripts that could be executed in the context of a user's browser session.
